Born Rostov-on-Don. Moved to Austria with his mother at nine (Inbusiness.kz). Ubitennis (Jan 2024) says he lives in Bratislava and trains in Austria. Mother is from Kazakhstan (Lada.kz). Played as neutral 2022 to Jan 2024, then KAZ from Jan 2024 (Montpellier). KTF said residence permit first, citizenship later. Decision 2026-10-28: switch_year stays 2024 and from_nation stays RUS (his passport nation, same as Kasatkina, who was also neutral first). In Oct 2022 a Stockholm results graphic showed a Kazakh flag, but the KTF only said his request was under review (C077) and Kazpravda says the flag seemed unexpected even to him (C076). That early flag is kept as an audit finding, not a switch date.

Announced 29 March 2025 after Australian permanent residency was approved. Decision 2026-10-28: to_nation is AUS because that is the flag she plays under, but she has permanent residency, not citizenship (AAP, WTA, her own post). Items that say 'citizen' or 'change of citizenship' (e.g. Mail.ru C098) keep that wording and get a note. Played as neutral 2022 to March 2025.

Not a voluntary switch. Same 1 March 2022 joint statement. Still a Belarusian citizen, said in 2026 she hopes to get the flag back after the IOC shift; ITF kept its position.
